item.text:
Implemented the voice broadcast liveness fix. Playback now tracks and emits `"live"`, `"grey"`, or `"not-live"` as playback and broadcast info change. The [playback hook](/app/src/voice-broadcast/hooks/useVoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts) passes that state to the UI, while the [badge](/app/src/voice-broadcast/components/atoms/LiveBadge.tsx) renders grey for buffering and paused broadcasts. Chunk sequencing now detects the last known event, including a replaced event.

I delegated the UI/type, hook, and chunk utility changes to three agents, then integrated and verified the patch. All 25 voice broadcast test suites passed (231 tests); ESLint, stylelint, and `git diff --check` passed. The full TypeScript check still fails on an unrelated existing error in [notifications.ts](/app/src/utils/notifications.ts:79) (`TS2554`).
